gerd_zinc_carnosine.name: Zinc-Carnosine
gerd_zinc_carnosine.key: 17 mg zinc + 58 mg L‑carnosine (75 mg zinc carnosine, as PepZin GI)
gerd_zinc_carnosine.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Zinc-Carnosine SS ND414' Rev. 1/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 capsule, 60 servings; zinc (as zinc-carnosine, PepZin GI) 17 mg, L-carnosine 58 mg; '75 mg zinc-carnosine per serving'; directions 'Take one capsule twice daily between meals'. Same amounts as products DB R154 (Metagenics chart). Sheet dose is 1 a day at bedtime, half the label's, to limit zinc (the plan's about 37 mg a day); GI Integrity's scoop (78 mg zinc carnosine, ND431) may take its place, never both. No current product-page URL turned up in the emails searched (they give links for GI Integrity, Spore Probio and Magnesium Glycinate only), so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: img-src/R154.png, a 4x Lanczos stopgap of the 88x160 chart thumbnail (SOFT): needs Asher's print master (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/ or the 10/1/26 catalog PDF).

gerd_dgl_pro.name: Licorice DGL Pro
gerd_dgl_pro.key: Per 3 tablets: 75 mg DGL extract, 100 mg glycine, 100 mg L‑glutamine, 30 mg NAC, 5 mg zinc
gerd_dgl_pro.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Licorice DGL Pro SS ND1337' Rev. 8/26, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 3 chewable tablets, 30 servings; zinc (as zinc glycinate) 5 mg, glycine 100 mg, L-glutamine 100 mg, deglycyrrhizinated licorice extract 75 mg, N-acetyl-cysteine 30 mg; directions 'Chew 3 tablets after each meal'. Same amounts as products DB R2193 (Integrative Therapeutics and Microbiome Labs charts); size R2193 90T on the 10/1/26 price list. Sheet uses 3 a day, after dinner (Asher's GERD protocol email, 2019-12-12: 'Chew three tablets as needed', or 1-3 before each meal) to limit zinc (the plan's about 37 mg a day). Asher linked https://nutridyn.com/licorice-dgl-pro in that 2019 email; nutridyn.com is blocked from this session and NutriDyn's slugs changed after 2020, so the sheet keeps the catalog-search link. A web-search index (checked 2026-11-03) does list https://nutridyn.com/licorice-dgl-pro as a NutriDyn product page: switch to it once a live check can confirm it. Photo: img-src/R2193.png, a 4x Lanczos stopgap of the 89x160 chart thumbnail (SOFT): needs Asher's print master.

gerd_gi_integrity.name: GI Integrity
gerd_gi_integrity.key: 3 g L‑glutamine, 400 mg DGL, 300 mg aloe, 200 mg slippery elm, 16 mg zinc (as zinc carnosine)
gerd_gi_integrity.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'GI Integrity SS ND431' Rev. 12/24, Berry Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): about 1 scoop (8.5 g), about 28 servings; zinc (as zinc-carnosine) 16.1 mg, L-glutamine 3 g, glucosamine HCl 1 g, apple pectin 1 g, DGL powder 400 mg, aloe vera leaf gel extract 300 mg, slippery elm 200 mg, marshmallow, chamomile, okra, cat's claw, MSM, quercetin and prune 100 mg each, L-carnosine 62 mg ('Features 78 mg of zinc-carnosine'); flavors peach tea, chocolate, berry; 'Warning: Do not use if pregnant or nursing'. Okra is on the label (the line leaves it out only for space). Amounts match the products DB R327 chart reads (Pure, DFH, Ortho, Apex). Size line names the three flavors only: 'about 28 servings' holds for the 238 g Peach Tea (R325) and Berry (R327) tubs, not the 362.9 g Chocolate tub (R328), whose panel is not printed. Directions (products DB R327): 'Mix one scoop with 6-8 ounces of water'. Sheet: 1 scoop daily in place of Zinc-Carnosine, never both (the protocol's chronic-reflux add-on is 1 scoop twice daily). URL: Asher's emails, 2024-01-18 and 2025-11-18; a web-search index (checked 2026-11-03) lists it as a live NutriDyn page. Photo: img-src/R325.png, 420 px original web render (Peach Tea). The tub fills only about 250x350 px of its 420x420 canvas, so it prints about 0.82 in tall; a central trim to the alpha box plus about 6 px would print it at the full 0.98 in (about 370 ppi).

gerd_spore_probio.name: UltraBiotic Spore Probio
gerd_spore_probio.key: Per 2 capsules: a 4‑strain spore probiotic blend (5 billion CFU), 300 mg XOS, 100 mg enzymes
gerd_spore_probio.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Spore Probio SS ND1135' Rev. 1/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 2 capsules, 30 servings; Spore Probiotic Complex 5 billion CFU (Weizmannia coagulans MTCC 5856, Pediococcus acidilactici NRRL B50517, Bacillus clausii MTCC 5980, Bacillus subtilis ATCC122264), xylooligosaccharides 300 mg, digestive enzyme blend 100 mg, PreforPro phage complex 15 mg; directions 'Take two capsules daily'. The key line follows the label's own name for the blend: Pediococcus acidilactici is a lactic-acid coccus that does not form spores, so 'spore-forming strains' would be wrong for one of the four. Same amounts as products DB R2196 (DFH, Ortho, Thorne, Microbiome Labs charts). URL from NutriDyn's launch email, 2024-04-04. Photo: img-src/R2196.png is for now a 4x Lanczos stopgap of the 86x160 chart thumbnail (SOFT). A 248x420 original NutriDyn web render of this exact bottle (Switch Kit page; 60 capsules, current label; compared side by side 2026-11-03) waits for a central hand copy over it, as was done for R716: stage_hires.py only replaces a file with a taller one, and 420 is less than 640. It then prints at about 430 ppi and leaves soft.json.

gerd_essential_multi_iron.name: Essential Multi with Iron
gerd_essential_multi_iron.key: Per 3 capsules: 18 mg iron, 15 mg zinc, 200 mcg B12, 1,360 mcg DFE folate, 120 mcg vitamin K
gerd_essential_multi_iron.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Essential Multi with Iron SS ND475' Rev. 09/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 3 capsules, 30/60 servings; iron (as ferrous bisglycinate chelate, Ferrochel) 18 mg, zinc (as zinc citrate) 15 mg, copper 1 mg, magnesium 40 mg, vitamin B12 (as methylcobalamin) 200 mcg, folate (as calcium L-5-MTHF, BioFolate) 1,360 mcg DFE, vitamin D3 25 mcg (1,000 IU), vitamin K (as phytonadione) 120 mcg, vitamin C 120 mg, vitamin A 3,000 mcg RAE (50% as mixed carotenoids); directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'; warnings: accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6, and 'Do not use if pregnant or nursing'. The key line leaves out vitamin D3 only for space; it keeps vitamin K, which matters to anyone on warfarin. Matches the products DB R717 chart reads of the catalog ND143 (10/1/26) panel. Sizes R717 90C and R717L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Asher's PPI-support email (2019-09-05) says 'Essential Multi'; the owner notes (2026-11-03) name the multi with iron. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: only the 87x160 chart thumbnail (products/img/R717.png), LOW-RES until the central stopgap step (stopgaps.py) makes a 4x Lanczos img-src/R717.png (SOFT); never the 254x420 R716 photo, which is the iron-free bottle. Needs Asher's print master.
